description: Fetch author detail by Open Library Author ID (OL…A). Returns bio, birth/death dates, photo IDs, and linked identifiers from Wikidata, VIAF, ISNI, Goodreads, and LibraryThing. Use openlibrary_search_authors to find an author ID first.

author_id.description: Open Library Author ID. Format: OL…A (e.g., "OL24638A"). A leading "/authors/" prefix is stripped if provided.

name: openlibrary_get_author

bio.description: Author biography. Absent when not provided.

birth_date.description: Birth date string. Absent when not recorded.

death_date.description: Death date string. Absent when not recorded.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: Author ID does not exist on Open Library, names a record that is not an author (a work or edition OLID), or redirects to no reachable author. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

fuller_name.description: Full name including middle names. Absent when not recorded.

notice.description: Set when the requested author ID was merged into a different canonical ID.

personal_name.description: Personal or given name. Absent when not recorded.

photo_ids.description: Numeric photo IDs. Pass to openlibrary_get_cover_url with target "author" and id_type "id".

remote_ids.description: Remote identifiers for cross-referencing with other databases.

title: Get Author
